title: IME 無効 input 経由で Browser タブのキー入力をリモート転送
entry_point: Browser タブ (/<repoId>/<branchId>/browser) の running 状態 noVNC viewport
state_diagram: running viewport mounted -> hidden input auto-focused -> keydown/keyup on input -> getKeysym/getKeycode -> rfb.sendKey(keysym, code, down) -> remote receives raw key. blur/unmount -> releaseAll (no stuck keys). leave tab -> input removed (no capture).

steps: Open the Browser tab in running state; the noVNC viewport + a hidden IME-disabled input mount.
Hidden input is auto-focused (keyboard capture active).

Dispatch keydown for an ASCII letter/digit/symbol/Enter/Backspace/Space (KeyA, Digit1, Enter, Backspace, Space) — including a keyCode:229 / isComposing:true variant that still carries a real e.code (simulating local OS IME ON).
Observe: rfb.sendKey is invoked with the correct keysym + code + down=true (captured via the __palmuxVncKeyTap test seam). The hidden input value stays empty (preventDefault).
Dispatch modifier keys (ControlLeft, ShiftLeft, AltLeft, MetaLeft) and special keys (ArrowUp, Escape, Tab, Delete, F1) — assert sendKey forwards each with correct keysym/code.
Hold a key (repeated keydown without keyup) — assert the same keysym is re-sent (no keysym drift).
Blur the input while a key is held — assert a keyup (down=false) is forwarded for the held key (no stuck key).
Mouse-down on the canvas — assert the hidden input regains focus (keys keep flowing) while the canvas still receives the pointer.
Navigate away from the Browser tab (to /bash) — assert the keyboard-capture input is removed from the DOM (no capture, no interference).
Navigate back to /browser — assert the capture input is present and focused again.

Assert the hidden input has type=password, autocomplete=off, aria-hidden=true, tabIndex=-1, an obscured name/id, and per-manager ignore attributes (data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore, data-form-type=other), and is off-screen (clip).

[MANUAL-SMOKE / real incus + real OS IME] turn ON a real OS Japanese IME and type into the live noVNC canvas: ASCII passes through AND Ctrl+Space -> remote fcitx5 -> nihongo converts to 日本語 in a remote textarea. Requires a human with a real OS IME (cannot be simulated headless).
